drivingQuestion: What principle divides the Rabbis and R' Yehuda?
outcomeNote: The dividing principle is stated for both sides

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ בְּמַאי קָמִיפַּלְגִי? רַבָּנַן סָבְרִי: יְדָא יַתִּירְתָּא זַכִּי לַהּ רַחֲמָנָא, וְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה סָבַר: בִּמְקוֹם אָבִיהָ – יָד דִּילַהּ לָאו כְּלוּם הִיא.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara asks: «With regard to what do» the Rabbis, who stated the unattributed first opinion in the mishna, and Rabbi Yehuda «disagree? The Rabbis hold: The Merciful One grants» the betrothed young woman «an additional hand,» beyond the hand of her father, who can receive the bill of divorce on her behalf. «And Rabbi Yehuda holds: In a place,» i.e., situation, where «her father» is alive, «her hand is nothing» and she is ineligible to receive her bill of divorce.
